name: Need for a Cure
label: Quest
description: Stranded along the rugged cliffs of northwestern Durotar, the Darkspear troll Rhinag lies poisoned by a venomtail scorpid. With precious little time…
intro: Stranded along the rugged cliffs of northwestern Durotar, the Darkspear troll Rhinag lies poisoned by a venomtail scorpid. With precious little time before the toxin finishes him, he relies on a courier to sprint to Orgrimmar and retrieve a cure from Kor'ghan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend... Your timing is perfect. I just hope I can compliment your haste as well.

I was careless while fighting a few of the venomtails nearby, and one of them stung me deeply. I can feel its poison weakening me even as we speak. At this rate, I got maybe an hour left to live. But I'll need your help if I'm to do so...
Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar knows how to make the antidote. Find him... And hurry, friend. I won't be able to last much longer. He should be in the Cleft of Shadow.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm almost glad I can't return to Sen'jin as I am now. My weakness and stupidity would surely be mocked.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, you've saved my life. Thank you.

Please take this; I hope it can at least help you in your travels, if not bring you some coin. From what you say, I won't be usin' it anytime soon. Kor'ghan is gonna march me through more of his rituals until I prove myself. More killin' boars, more gatherin' scorpid tails...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
